title: Tiny, cute tent
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- ground shadow -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='88' rx='34' ry='6' fill='#1d3b52'/>
  <!-- tent body -->
  <polygon points='50,18 18,84 82,84' fill='#ff8a3d'/>
  <!-- tent side shading -->
  <polygon points='50,18 82,84 50,84' fill='#e56d22'/>
  <!-- left flap -->
  <polygon points='50,18 18,84 38,84' fill='#ffd166'/>
  <!-- opening -->
  <polygon points='50,32 34,82 66,82' fill='#7b3f02'/>
  <!-- opening inner highlight -->
  <polygon points='50,36 37,80 50,80' fill='#9e5508'/>
  <!-- front seam detail -->
  <line x1='50' y1='18' x2='50' y2='84' stroke='#c95610' stroke-width='2.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- ridge pole -->
  <line x1='50' y1='14' x2='50' y2='20' stroke='#ffe08a' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- guy line left -->
  <line x1='50' y1='22' x2='12' y2='88' stroke='#ffd166' stroke-width='1.8' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- guy line right -->
  <line x1='50' y1='22' x2='88' y2='88' stroke='#ffd166' stroke-width='1.8' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- pegs -->
  <rect x='10' y='86' width='6' height='4' rx='1' fill='#c9e4ff'/>
  <rect x='84' y='86' width='6' height='4' rx='1' fill='#c9e4ff'/>
  <!-- tent base trim -->
  <rect x='18' y='82' width='64' height='4' rx='2' fill='#ffe08a'/>
  <!-- little flag on top -->
  <line x1='50' y1='8' x2='50' y2='18' stroke='#c9e4ff' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <polygon points='50,8 66,12 50,16' fill='#5ce1e6'/>
  <!-- star decoration left -->
  <polygon points='24,54 26,60 32,60 27,64 29,70 24,66 19,70 21,64 16,60 22,60' fill='#fff59d'/>
  <!-- moon decoration right -->
  <circle cx='72' cy='48' r='7' fill='#fff59d'/>
  <circle cx='75' cy='46' r='6' fill='#e56d22'/>
</svg>
